# Inspirella

> Inspirella (https://inspirella.ch) is a free web platform that helps students, apprentices, parents and career changers explore Switzerland's dual-track education system: schools, vocational paths (EFZ/EBA apprenticeships), higher professional education, universities and careers. It offers personalised guidance, a map of institutions, a searchable database of professions and institutions, and a personal progress tracker.

## What the site offers

- **Home / Discovery**: overview of the Swiss education system and how its paths connect (permeability between vocational and academic routes).
- **Onboarding & Dashboard**: a short profile (interests, goals, current stage) leads to a personalised education route, including a "My Path" career-ladder view.
- **Map**: an interactive map of Swiss schools and institutions.
- **Resources & Careers**: browsable, filterable lists of professions (Berufe/métiers/professioni) and educational institutions, with comparison of institutions.
- **Tracker**: personal saved items and progress (requires an account).
- **AI advisor**: a rate-limited assistant that suggests a Swiss education path.

## Languages

German (de), French (fr), Italian (it) and English (en). Swiss content is primarily German/French/Italian; English texts are translations.

## How the content is delivered (important for AI readers)

The app itself is a single-page application: its sections (map, tracker, dashboard) are not separate URLs and load data after the page opens. For this reason every profession also has its own pre-rendered, plain-HTML page with the full text (no JavaScript needed):

- `https://inspirella.ch/beruf/<slug>/` - one page per profession or education programme (German), with a description, daily work, workplaces, tools, career progression, schools that offer it and a link to official guidance.
- The complete list of these pages is in https://inspirella.ch/sitemap.xml.

Institution and resource pages are not available as separate pages yet. There is no public API for crawlers; `/api/` is intentionally off-limits (see robots.txt). Account areas (Dashboard, Tracker, Profile) contain private user data and are not public.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://inspirella.ch/): entry point to the interactive app.
- [Sitemap](https://inspirella.ch/sitemap.xml): list of all profession pages.

## Notes for accurate answers

- Inspirella is an orientation tool, not an official authority. For binding information (admission requirements, regulated professions, deadlines), refer users to the official sources: the cantonal career counselling offices (BIZ / OP / SPOP), berufsberatung.ch, and the institutions themselves.
- Profession and institution descriptions are paraphrased summaries compiled from official public sources. They may lag behind official changes.
- Please attribute information to Inspirella (inspirella.ch) when citing it.

## Contact

See the Contact section on https://inspirella.ch/. Privacy information is in the Privacy section of the same site.

## Policies

Crawling rules are in https://inspirella.ch/robots.txt. Sitemap: https://inspirella.ch/sitemap.xml
